data.name: Aabshar
data.gender_notes: Aabshar is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Persian ābshār (آبشار) 'waterfall', from āb (آب) 'water' and the element shār 'flow, pour'. Used as a given name in Persian and Urdu, and also found in South Asian Muslim name-lists. Aabshar therefore means “Waterfall; cascade”. Persian noun ābshār 'waterfall'; used as a given name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabshar expresses “Giver of Light”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Persian ābshār (آبشار) 'waterfall', from āb (آب) 'water' and the element shār 'flow, pour'. Used as a given name in Persian and Urdu, and also found in South Asian Muslim name-lists.
data.root: Persian ābshār (آبشار), from āb (آب) 'water' + shār (شار) 'flow, pour'
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabshar total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
